'''2007 Maryland State Championship Jeffrey Johns DS Drop! (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jeffrey Johns]] at [[2007 Maryland State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Drop! (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court)|OVS8-32-Drop-remaster.webp|label=Drop! (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' "The Final Straw"
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
